description: The slow sky shift brief section 13's hidden pressure is allowed to make, one row per S9 HeatBand. Only the band's name crosses the bridge; cthulhu_heat itself never does, so the most this table can express is which of four rooms the world is in.

notes: Felt before it is read: the shift is small per band and slow in time (atmosphere.transitions owns the duration), so the player notices the island has changed colour before anything tells them why.
No bar, no percentage, no number on screen. Section 13 keeps the pressure hidden and this table is the only thing that shows it at all.
